topic: The Curious Link: Elastic Collisions and the Digits of Pi
target_audience: High school students interested in physics and computer science

sections.title: The Setup: The Idealized Collision System
lecture_lines: Consider two blocks on a frictionless surface.
Small mass m, large mass M.
Momentum and kinetic energy are conserved.
